miles north of Milesburg to over Franklinville, moving east at 55
mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to trees, roofs, and siding.

State College, Lock Haven, Bellefonte, Park Forest Village,
Carroll, Woodward, Boalsburg, Pleasant Gap, Lamar, Stormstown,
Lemont, Zion, Houserville, Warriors Mark, Mill Hall, Pine Grove
Mills, Milroy, Avis, Dunnstown and Flemington.

windows. These storms are capable of producing damaging winds.

structure.

properties.headline: Dust Storm Warning issued October 16 at 10:44AM MST until October 16 at 12:45PM MST by NWS Phoenix AZ
properties.description:
The National Weather Service in Phoenix has issued a

* Dust Storm Warning for...
Pinal County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 1245 PM MST.

* At 1044 AM MST, a plume of dust was located 8 miles north of
Maricopa, or 8 miles west of Sun Lakes, and was stationary along
Highway 347.

HAZARD...Less than a quarter mile visibility.

SOURCE...Satellite observations and traffic cameras.

IMPACT...Dangerous life-threatening travel.

* Locations impacted include...
Mainly rural areas of Pinal County.

This includes AZ Route 347 between mile markers 180 and 184.
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not drive into a dust storm. PULL ASIDE STAY ALIVE!

Dust storms lead to dangerous driving conditions with visibility
reduced to near zero. If driving, avoid dust storms if possible. If
caught in one, pull off the road, turn off your lights and keep your
foot off the brake.

There is no safe place on a highway when a dust storm hits.
Visibility can be lost immediately, making it difficult or impossible
to slow down and avoid stopped vehicles. Delay travel, or safely exit
the highway before the dust storm arrives.

CMAMtext: NWS: DUST STORM WARNING til 12:45 PM MST. Be ready for a sudden drop to zero visibility.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: DUST STORM WARNING for this area until 12:45 PM MST. Be ready for sudden drop to zero visibility. Pull Aside, Stay Alive! When visibility drops, pull far off the road and put your vehicle in park. Turn the lights off and keep your foot off the brake. Infants, the elderly and those with respiratory issues urged to take precautions.

properties.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 16 at 11:40AM MDT until October 17 at 12:00AM MDT by NWS El Paso Tx/Santa Teresa NM
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the Blowing Dust Advisory, visibility between
one-quarter and one mile in blowing dust possible at times. For the
Wind Advisory, east winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 50 mph.

* WHERE...Portions of Southwest New Mexico.

* WHEN...For the Blowing Dust Advisory, until 8 PM MDT this evening.
For the Wind Advisory, until midnight MDT tonight.

* IMPACTS...Hazardous driving conditions due to reduced visibility.
Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree limbs could be
blown down and a few power outages may result.
properties.instruction:
Persons with respiratory problems should make preparations to stay
indoors until the storm passes. Be ready for a sudden drop in
visibility to near zero. If you encounter blowing dust or blowing
sand on the roadway or see it approaching, pull off the road as far
as possible and put your vehicle in park. Turn the lights all the way
off and keep foot off the brake pedal. Remember, 'Pull Aside, Stay
Alive'.

Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

NWSheadline: BLOWING DUST ADVISORY REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 8 PM MDT THIS EVENING... ...WIND ADVISORY REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL MIDNIGHT MDT TONIGHT
